description: This Java class 'ConfigurationModulesLoader' provides utility methods for serializing and deserializing 'IntegrationConfiguration' objects to and from JSON strings, primarily used for loading configuration modules within the application.

classes.name: ConfigurationModulesLoader
classes.description: A utility class for handling JSON serialization and deserialization of integration configurations.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts a map of IntegrationConfiguration objects into a JSON string representing a JSON array.

methods.name: loadIntegrationConfigurations
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to reconstruct a map of IntegrationConfiguration objects.
